status: candidate; visual interpretation, not final historical reproduction
coordinate_system: normalized from top-left of each cropped WebP; origin is top-left, x right, y down
handle_anchor: approximate handle midpoint for overlay on visible empty grip; adjust visually at target size

shared_pose_transforms.policy: one shared transform per attack pose applied to every C001 generation; sword image is common and shown in front of the full character cutout
shared_pose_transforms.sword_scale: uniform; weapon height about 0.74 × character frame height
shared_pose_transforms.grip_contact: approximate hand-near-handle placement; exact finger wrapping is not a requirement
shared_pose_transforms.adjustment_rule: Check all seven C001 sets at reduced size. If the same transform clearly fails only across standing vs wheelchair poses, split by those two pose structures, not by age or character.
shared_pose_transforms.pose_coverage: same transform by pose is applied to all C001 generations; example preview includes all seven sets
shared_pose_transforms.intermediate_animation: After key poses and shared transforms are approved, add wind-up and follow-through in-between character poses for a smooth sword-swing animation.
